task.title: Example: Opportunity Forecast Application
task.shortdesc: You will use the following app components to build your new app.

step.cmd: The end-user invokes all opportunities, for which they are an owner, from your environment into Excel.
For each Opportunity includes Name, Amount, Close Date, Stage, and Owner Id.
Allow the end-user to save modifications to only the Amount and Stage for each Opportunity.
Select Objects to use in the app.
Create a Display and Save Maps.
Create Query, Display, and Save actions.
